text:
Source-assisted reading of F-gi8c (Stams, Frg. 17). All four text lines were reread on the native images at reading size, with the Vulgate and the gradual text at hand; a second research reader reread the same four lines. Boxes are x,y,width,height in native pixels. (x) expansion, [ ] lost or supplied, ? doubtful.

Canvas 0 (Stams_STA_Frg_017_01r), 2150 x 300 at 2550,1940
l.1  [...]re? edebat & p(re)dicabat dicens. Veniet forti[or]      (V touched red; tops of letters cut; letters before "edebat" uncertain, possibly "[...]stre")
l.2  [post?] me cuius no(n) sum dignus p(ro)cumbens solue(re) corri[giam]      (first word on the curled corner; traces only)

Canvas 1 (Stams_STA_Frg_017_01v), 2150 x 300 at 2800,1860
l.1  pace in credendo · ut habundetis in spe & uirtu[te]
l.2  Ex syon sp(eci)es decoris eius d(eu)s manifeste ueniet. V(ersus) Congregate ill[i]      (E red-filled; red versicle sign; C touched red)

Below l.2 on canvas 1: a later hand-drawn staff with hollow notes in lighter ink, not transcribed.
